versions.text:
There must be at least one hand fire extinguisher for use in the UCS that is located within easy access of UCS crew. For hand fire extinguishers the following apply:
(a) The type and quantity of each extinguishing agent used must be appropriate to the kinds of fire likely to occur when that agent is used.
(b) Each extinguisher must be designed to minimise the hazard of toxic gas concentrations.
